crossPage: The whole page is an artifact type ('Draft a Mail') inside the Chat + Artifacts split. Row '50:50 in 1440' (10342:201187) and its 'artifact only' / 'artifact only as a viewer' sub-journeys repeat the Chat + Artifacts layouts: 'chat-artifact' (chat + artifact split), 'artifact-full-editor' and 'artifact-view-viewer'. Build them as the mail variant of those templates, not as new screens.

'edit with AI' and the row-2 'Editing email content with AI' / 'Ai Edit - Input box' steps use the same select-text-then-AI-edit pattern as Projects + Chat History 'instructions-ai-edit' (5534:215248). One AI-edit popover component should serve both.
'Multi File View' (10635:331081) and the 1440x800 'Modal Full Screen' previews are the file viewer / preview modal also used for artifacts and project files.
'chat quote style of the portion of text' (10077:327578) matches the quote-in-chat behaviour of the Chat + Artifacts composer.

doubts.q: The rows at y=1469 (labels 'select to edit' ... 'schedule option 1') and y=2629 ('Adding attachment') have no title card. Are they the continuation of 'Draft an mail flow' (one long journey: recipients -> AI edit -> schedule -> attachments) or separate journeys?
doubts.proposedDefault: Separate journeys under the same card: 'draft-mail-ai-edit' and 'draft-mail-attachments'. Each starts from the composed draft at the end of 'draft-mail' (10077:286845).

doubts.q: Row 2 runs on past 'schedule option 1' with 10631:1654754 (snackbar on it), 10734:435033 and two 1440x800 'Modal Full Screen' frames (10734:438249, 12264:514091). Are the two modals the end of the schedule flow, or a separate preview modal (like the attachment preview at the bottom of the page) parked on the same row?
doubts.proposedDefault: Keep them as steps 8-10 of 'draft-mail-ai-edit' in left-to-right order; if they turn out to be the attachment preview, move them to 'draft-mail-attachments'.

doubts.q: The last row's card is a designer question: 'when some attachments are failed to upload then how preview modal should look like, do we need to show some error description in preview modal.' It shows two preview modals side by side (12264:514198, 11765:540541). Are these two competing answers, or two steps (with and without the error description)?
doubts.proposedDefault: Treat them as the left-to-right steps of one journey: 11765:534931 (draft with a failed attachment) -> 12264:514198 -> 11765:540541. Show an error line in the preview for each failed file.

doubts.q: 'add atleast one recipient' (card 10631:1656046, frame 10631:1659015 + Alert) sits outside the section at 30% opacity, next to the parked 'schedule option 2' frames. Is the 'add at least one recipient' validation alert live?
doubts.proposedDefault: Yes, as an error state only: pressing Send with no recipients shows the alert. The frame is mapped and flagged dimmed.
